agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/aligned_indent.py: AlignedIndentFilter._process_parenthesis incorrectly anchored the inserted SELECT newline token on tlist[1] (assumed to be whitespace after '('), which broke when there was no space between '(' and 'SELECT' (the common case), causing the newline to be inserted after SELECT instead of before it. Changed anchor to tlist[0] (the opening parenthesis); insert_after already skips whitespace to find the correct insertion point before SELECT. Verified fix resolves both 'format reindent aligned: basic' and 'format reindent aligned: group by subquery' scenarios, and does not regress simple non-subquery aligned formatting.
